context.title: California School Nurses Organization: positions from signed ballot arguments, 2026-11-03 California general election

subject.title: California — Proposition 3 (Provides Permanent Funding for Schools and Health Care by Extending Existing Tax on High Incomes)

positions.statement: Katie Nilsson (RN, President) signed the argument in favor of Proposition 3 in the official voter guide.

subject.title: California — Proposition 44 (Requires Community Health Clinics Spend 90% Of Revenue on Program Services)

positions.statement: Katie Nilsson (RN, President) signed the argument against Proposition 44 in the official voter guide.
